title: Pilot Checks
lead: All your ad KPIs, one by one: the number, when it is good, bad or to stop, and what to do. You can set everything.

step.title: Step 1: your rules
step.text: Here you set the rules. Pilotix does not use them yet: it does not block, ring or judge with them. That comes in the next steps.

levelHelp.off: Pilotix does not look at this KPI.
levelHelp.doctor: It happened: Pilotix names the KPI, with its numbers and what to do.
levelHelp.bell: It rings early, before money is lost.
levelHelp.door: The mistake can't happen: the button stays locked.

door.price: when a price or a cost is saved

data.reason: A reason is missing in the agents' list
data.tags: The videos have no tags yet
data.tick: A person has to tick a list
data.none: Pilotix does not have this data
data.unverified: To check: does Pilotix keep this data?

dataSum: Today Pilotix has the data for {{ready}} of the {{total}} KPIs. {{toAdd}} need something added, {{unverified}} are to check.

ed.fixed: This KPI has no number to set.
ed.own: Empty: Pilotix's own words come back.
ed.noDoor: This KPI has no door: no button can be locked for it.
ed.badOrder: The first number must be smaller than the second.
ed.badWait: Type a whole number, 1 or more.
ed.proofNote: This stop waits until the ad has the age you set and Pilotix is sure (see General settings).
ed.badLinesUp: The numbers must go up: good, then bad, then stop or urgent.
ed.badLinesDown: The numbers must go down: good, then bad, then stop or urgent.

log.title: Last changes
log.empty: No change yet. Every change you make is kept here.

D1.name: Profit kept
D1.kpi: Ad cost of a confirmed order ÷ the product’s bid limit
D1.do: Good: the budget goes up one step if the ad set spends almost everything. Average: nothing moves. Bad: the budget goes down one step. Stop: the ad is switched off, only when Pilotix is sure.
D1.also: Offer: if the bid limit is lower than your cheapest cost, the margin is too thin (price, supplier, packs)

D7.name: Account brake
D7.kpi: Ad cost of a confirmed order on all your SCALE ads ÷ what their bid limits allow (tests are not counted)
D7.do: No new product is tested while it lasts. Ads already running keep running. The brake lifts the first day back to normal.

D2.name: Cost of a delivered order
D2.kpi: Ad spend ÷ delivered orders, compared with the bid limit
D2.do: Read it with “Profit kept”. If that one is good and this one is bad, the problem is the parcels (returns, refusals), not the ad.

D3.name: Cost of a lead
D3.kpi: Ad spend ÷ leads (forms sent), compared with the bid limit
D3.do: An early signal during tests. It never stops anything: “Profit kept” decides.

D4.name: Net profit of the month
D4.kpi: Cash collected − products − team − returns − ads − rent and salaries (in DA)
D4.do: Under 0: no new product is tested. If it falls 10% two months in a row: find the cause before adding products.

D5.name: Cost of a return
D5.kpi: Return fees paid to the courier ÷ returned parcels
D5.do: Pilotix updates the return cost used in the bid limit. Nothing to do.

D6.name: Winner rate
D6.kpi: Winning products ÷ products tested, over 4 weeks
D6.do: Bad: review your product choices and offers before testing more. Stop: no new product is tested, only when Pilotix is sure.

Q1.name: Ad quality
Q1.kpi: Real leads ÷ all the leads of this ad (fake numbers, wrong numbers and no answer shown apart)
Q1.do: Bad: find the reason (fake numbers, wrong audience). Stop: the ad is switched off, only when Pilotix is sure.

Q2.name: Leads quality
Q2.kpi: Confirmed orders ÷ real leads of this ad
Q2.do: Bad: listen to the calls, look at the cancel reasons. Stop: the ad is switched off, only when Pilotix is sure.
Q2.also: Video: if this ad confirms 10 points less than the product’s other ads, it attracts the curious: a new, more honest video

Q3.name: Delivery quality
Q3.kpi: Parcels delivered or refused at the door ÷ finished parcels of this ad (the rest = fake parcels)
Q3.do: Bad: check phone and address at confirmation; Suivi calls back the fake parcels. Stop: the ad is switched off, only when Pilotix is sure.

Q4.name: Delivered rate
Q4.kpi: Parcels delivered ÷ delivered + refused at the door, for this ad
Q4.do: Bad: look at the refusal reasons. Stop: the ad is switched off, only when Pilotix is sure.
Q4.also: Offer: if this ad delivers 10 points less than the product’s other ads, the promise is too big: compare the price said on the call, the page, the fees, the delay, the size

O20.name: Stock
O20.kpi: Pieces in stock ÷ pieces confirmed per day (average of the last 7 days)
O20.do: Bad: reorder 21 days of stock the same day. Stop: no new spend on the product. At 0 pieces its ads are switched off until stock is back.

O1.name: Nobody wants it
O1.kpi: Link clicks ÷ people who saw the ad, on each of 3 or more different videos (first 3 seconds normal)
O1.tail: on every one of the videos
O1.do: Stop the product. Test another one.

O2.name: Bad quality
O2.kpi: Delivered orders with a complaint ÷ all delivered orders
O2.do: Bad: fix the problem with the supplier. Stop: the product is stopped, only when Pilotix is sure.

O3.name: Everyone already has it
O3.kpi: Leads per 1,000 DA spent this week ÷ your normal of the 4 weeks before
O3.tail: for 3 weeks in a row, and a new video fails too
O3.do: New model or new version. The budget of its ad sets goes down one step for 2 weeks.

O4.name: Colour or size missing
O4.kpi: Cancelled orders with reason “Not my colour / size” ÷ all cancelled orders
O4.do: Add the asked colours and sizes.

O5.name: Too expensive
O5.kpi: Cancelled orders with reason “Price too high” ÷ all cancelled orders
O5.do: Add value first (gift, pack). Lower the price only if profit stays.
O5.also: Page trust: show your values, so the price feels fair

O6.name: Delivery fee too high
O6.kpi: Cancelled orders with reason “Delivery fee too high” ÷ all cancelled orders
O6.also: Landing page: show the fee early

O7.name: Too cheap to be trusted
O7.kpi: Cancelled orders with reason “Is it fake?” ÷ all cancelled orders
O7.do: Proof first: real photos, reviews. Raise the price only if it goes on 2 weeks after the proof.
O7.also: Page trust: reviews and real photos

O9.name: Your costs went up
O9.kpi: Cost of one piece this month ÷ cost of one piece last month
O9.do: Renegotiate, or raise the price by the same amount.

O10.name: Same as everyone
O10.kpi: Cancelled orders with reason “Ordered elsewhere” ÷ all cancelled orders
O10.do: Add something they don't have: gift, guarantee, faster delivery.
O10.also: Page trust: awareness ads on your values

O11.name: No reason to buy now
O11.kpi: Orders with answer “I'll think about it” ÷ all orders not confirmed
O11.do: A real time limit: offer ends Friday, limited stock.
O11.also: Landing page: show the time limit

O12a.name: Small basket
O12a.do: Offer “2 for…”. The agent proposes a second piece.
O12a.also: Team: the agent proposes a second piece

O12b.name: The pack doesn't attract
O12b.kpi: Orders that took a pack ÷ all orders
O12b.do: Make the pack saving bigger and show it first.
O12b.also: Landing page: show the pack first

O14.name: Fear, no guarantee
O14.kpi: Cancelled orders with reason “I'm afraid / I want to see first” ÷ all cancelled orders
O14.do: Say it clearly: open and check before paying, exchange possible.
O14.also: Page trust and landing page: show the guarantee

O15.name: Delivery too slow
O15.kpi: Cancelled orders with reason “Takes too long” ÷ all cancelled orders
O15.do: Show the real delay per wilaya. Ship the same day.

O16.name: The offer is confusing
O16.kpi: Confirmed orders changed during the call ÷ all confirmed orders
O16.do: Fewer choices: one main offer, one pack.

O17.name: Wrong season
O17.kpi: Leads per 1,000 DA of this category this month ÷ last month
O17.tail: while 2 or more other categories stay between 90% and 110%
O17.do: The category’s budget goes down one step this month. Push in-season products.

O18.name: Competitor dropped price
O18.kpi: Their new price ÷ their old price, plus the reason “Cheaper elsewhere”
O18.tail: and that reason rises the same week
O18.do: Wait 3 days. If orders fall: add a pack or a gift before cutting the price.
O18.also: Page trust: awareness ads on your values

O19.name: Competitor launched the same
O19.kpi: New pages launching the same model in 7 days (to check every Monday in Meta’s Ad Library)
O19.do: New angle, stronger proof, faster delivery message.
O19.also: Page trust: awareness on your values. Video: a new angle

V1.name: Weak first 3 seconds
V1.kpi: People who stay 3 seconds ÷ times shown (same placement)
V1.do: 3 new first-3-seconds, each in a new video. A running ad is never edited.

V2.name: Boring body
V2.kpi: People who watch to the end or 15 seconds ÷ people who stay 3 seconds (first 3 seconds normal)
V2.do: Shorten. Cut dead moments. Change the scene every 2–3 seconds.

V3.name: Product shown too late
V3.kpi: People who reach a quarter of the video ÷ people who stay 3 seconds
V3.do: Show the product in use before second 5.

V4.name: Entertains but doesn't sell
V4.kpi: People who click the link ÷ people who saw the ad
V4.tail: while the start and the middle are normal and another ad of the product gets clicks
V4.do: Add the product’s value and “order now”. No price in the video.
V4.also: Offer: if all videos click low, it's the offer

V5a.name: Not understood (comments)
V5a.kpi: Comments asking “What is it?” ÷ all comments
V5a.do: Show the product working, step by step.

V5b.name: Not understood (calls)
V5b.kpi: Cancelled orders with reason “I didn’t understand” ÷ cancelled orders from this ad
V5b.do: Show the product working, step by step. With “Not understood (comments)”: one new video only.

V8.name: Copy of another video
V8.kpi: Same angle + same first scene + same person as a live video
V8.do: Make a truly new idea, not a variation.

V9.name: Tired video
V9.kpi: First-3-seconds number this week ÷ the same in its first week
V9.tail: while each person saw it 3 times or more
V9.do: New first 3 seconds on the same idea. Never edit the winner.

V10.name: Meta won't show it
V10.kpi: This ad’s spend ÷ its ad set’s spend, over 3 days
V10.tail: while the ad set spends almost all its budget
V10.do: In SCALE: one retest only, in the next {{testDay}} test. In TEST: it is simply “to retest”. No budget or bid change.

L11.name: The page does not convert
L11.do: Look at the page KPIs just below: one of them explains why.

L1.name: Page slow
L1.do: Lighter photos. Test on a cheap phone with 4G.

L2.name: The top doesn't hold them
L2.kpi: Forms started ÷ page views, next to another page of the same product
L2.do: First screen: same picture and promise as the video, the price, “pay on delivery”.

L3.name: Doesn't match the video
L3.kpi: Forms started ÷ page views, for each video
L3.tail: of the number with the best video
L3.do: Same photo and same words as that video.
L3.also: Video: or change the video's promise

L4.name: Form too long
L4.kpi: Orders ÷ forms started (“Price too high” normal)
L4.do: Only name, phone, wilaya, commune. A big button.
L4.also: Offer: if “Price too high” is high, it's the price

L5.name: Fee surprise
L5.kpi: Forms left after choosing the wilaya ÷ forms started
L5.do: Show the delivery fees before the form.

L8.name: Button hidden
L8.kpi: Visitors who reach the button ÷ visitors
L8.do: Button on the first screen, repeated down the page.

L9.name: Weak pictures
L9.kpi: Picture list: number of “yes” out of 10
L9.do: Redo the “no” lines: real photo, size shown, benefit shown.

L12.name: Form broken
L12.kpi: Pages that do not open + forms sent with no order created (count)
L12.tail: in 1 hour, or once if a person confirms it
L12.do: Fix it now. If a person confirms the failure, the ads to this page are paused until the fix. Those days do not count against the ad.

P1.name: The page looks empty
P1.do: Post 2–3 times a week: products, customers, behind the scenes.

P2.name: Bad comments under the ads
P2.kpi: Negative comments ÷ all comments on the ads
P2.do: Answer each one within the day. Hide insults. Fix the real cause.
P2.also: Offer or team: the cause is often there

P3.name: Messages not answered
P3.kpi: Messages answered within 1 hour ÷ all messages
P3.do: Answer faster, or let Pilot Message answer.

P4a.name: Not enough reviews
P4a.kpi: New real reviews from delivered customers, over 30 days (count)
P4a.do: Ask each customer for a review the day after delivery.

P4b.name: Not enough customer photos
P4b.kpi: New customer photos or videos posted with their permission, over 30 days (count)
P4b.do: Ask for a photo after delivery. Post them.

P5.name: People don't know the shop
P5.kpi: Cancelled orders with reason “I don't know the shop / no trust” ÷ all cancelled orders
P5.do: Awareness ads on your values: who you are, the guarantee, real customers.

P7.name: Customers don't come back
P7.kpi: Customers with a second order ÷ customers delivered
P7.do: A message after delivery, and a code for the next order.

P8.name: Meta finds the ads low quality
P8.kpi: Meta's quality ranking of the ad
P8.do: Less clickbait, honest claims, answer the comments.

M1.name: Tracking broken
M1.kpi: Landing page orders with an ad ID ÷ all landing page orders
M1.do: Put the tracking tag (ad.id) on every ad the same day. Without it an ad is not launched.

M2.name: Meta counts wrong
M2.kpi: Purchases counted by Meta ÷ orders in Pilotix
M2.do: Check the pixel and the Conversions API.

M13.name: Meta matches your customers badly
M13.kpi: Meta’s “Event Match Quality” score for Purchase (out of 10)
M13.do: Send Meta the phone, first name and wilaya of each order (protected as Meta requires).

M3.name: Too few ideas
M3.do: One truly new idea per week.

M4.name: One idea takes everything
M4.kpi: Spend of the top idea ÷ total spend
M4.tail: and no new idea for 7 days
M4.do: Launch new ideas before the top one gets tired.

M5.name: Learning restarted
M5.kpi: Edits or budget changes over {{budgetStep}} in 7 days (count)
M5.do: No edits for {{freezeDays}}. Raise budgets by {{budgetStep}} at most.

M6.name: Bid cap too high
M6.kpi: Bid cap ÷ the most you can pay for one order
M6.do: Lower the cap to what your confirmation and delivery rates allow.

M7.name: The ad set does not spend
M7.kpi: Spent ÷ budget over 3 days (SCALE ad set)
M7.do: Bid cap under the bid limit: +10%, once only. Bid cap already at the bid limit: leave it, launch a new idea in the next test.
M7.also: Video: if only one ad doesn't spend, it's the video

M8.name: Cost of views up
M8.kpi: Cost of 1,000 views this week ÷ your normal cost, on all ads
M8.do: Check the season and the competitors. Add new ideas.

M11.name: Account trouble
M11.kpi: Rejected ads or failed payments in 7 days (count)
M11.do: Fix the payment. Rewrite the rejected ad.

M12.name: Loses when scaling
M12.kpi: Cost per order after a budget raise ÷ cost per order before
M12.do: Go back one step. Scale with new ideas, not only budget.

T14.name: Calls not logged
T14.kpi: Called leads with a logged result ÷ called leads
T14.do: Log the result of every call the same day. While it is bad, Pilotix judges neither the agents nor the reasons.

T13.name: Confirmations drop
T13.kpi: Confirmed ÷ real leads today, compared with your normal of the last 7 days
T13.do: Look first at call speed and the number of tries, then ad quality, then the form.

T1.name: Calls too late
T1.kpi: Orders first called within 1 hour ÷ all orders
T1.do: Call new orders first. More agents at peak hours.

T2.name: Not enough tries
T2.kpi: Unreachable orders with fewer than 3 call tries ÷ unreachable orders
T2.do: Three tries at different hours, plus a message.

T3.name: An agent confirms too little
T3.kpi: Confirmed ÷ real leads of the agent, minus the other agents’ number (same products)
T3.do: Bad: coaching (2 listened calls + sales guide every week). Urgent: listen to 5 calls. Change the agent after 4 weeks with no progress.

T4.name: An agent confirms too easily
T4.kpi: The agent's delivered ÷ confirmed, minus the team's
T4.do: Confirm the address, the price and the date on every call.

T5.name: No upsell
T5.kpi: Confirmed orders with an upsell ÷ confirmed orders, per agent
T5.do: Propose the second piece or the pack on every call.

T6a.name: Abandoned forms not called
T6a.kpi: Abandoned forms called within 30 minutes ÷ abandoned forms
T6a.do: Put them at the top of the call list.

T6b.name: Abandoned forms not recovered
T6b.kpi: Abandoned forms turned into orders ÷ abandoned forms called
T6b.do: A call script made for abandoned forms.

T7.name: Slow shipping
T7.kpi: Confirmed orders shipped within 24 hours ÷ confirmed orders
T7.do: Prepare and hand over the same day.

T8a.name: Slow delivery everywhere
T8a.kpi: Days between shipping and delivery, all wilayas (half of the parcels arrive sooner)

T8b.name: Slow delivery in a wilaya
T8b.kpi: Days from shipped to delivered, per wilaya
T8b.do: Push the courier, or change it for that wilaya.

T9.name: Weak wilaya
T9.kpi: Delivered parcels ÷ finished parcels in that wilaya
T9.do: First the announced delay, then the courier. Stop: the wilaya is removed from the ads, only when Pilotix is sure.

T10.name: Parcels not followed
T10.kpi: Parcels in delivery over 3 days with no follow-up call ÷ parcels in delivery over 3 days
T10.do: Suivi calls the customer and the courier.

T11.name: Fake orders pass
T11.kpi: Orders shipped from a phone that already has 2 refusals or fake parcels (count)
T11.do: The 3rd order is blocked before confirmation. One more call before shipping for those with 1 refusal.

T12.name: Returns come back late
T12.kpi: Returned parcels back in stock within 10 days ÷ returned parcels

gt.x: {{v}} times the bid limit or less

set.title: General settings
set.lead: The numbers that belong to no single KPI. Each shop sets its own.
set.startNone: At the start: not filled in
set.bad: Type a whole number between {{min}} and {{max}}.

judgeDays.name: Days before an ad is judged
judgeDays.help: Before that, Pilotix never switches an ad off for its results. Zero stock still switches off at once.

proofPct.name: How sure Pilotix must be before it switches off
proofPct.help: At 5%, it switches off only if there are fewer than 5 chances in 100 that it is bad luck. Higher: it stops faster, and stops more good ads.

keepGood.name: Share of profit you keep at the bid limit
keepGood.help: The bid limit is what a confirmed order may cost in ads while keeping this share.

delivered.name: Delivered rate counted at the start
delivered.help: Used for the bid limit until a product has 30 finished parcels. After that, its real rate.

returnCost.name: Cost of a returned parcel
returnCost.help: Used in the bid limit. Pilotix updates it every month with your real fees.

limitMove.name: The bid limit moves only if it changes by at least
limitMove.help: It is recomputed once a week. Under this change it stays the same, so bid caps are not touched for nothing.

budgetStep.name: One budget step
budgetStep.help: How much an ad set’s budget goes up or down at a time.

budgetCuts.name: Cuts in a row at most
budgetCuts.help: After that, if the ad set still costs too much, its worst ad is switched off.

budgetBase.name: Base budget per product
budgetBase.help: An ad set’s budget never goes under this amount times its products. In your ad account’s currency.

groupBand.name: Bid limit gap allowed in a group
groupBand.help: Products share an ad set only if their bid limits are close.

ownOrders.name: A winner gets its own ad set from
ownOrders.help: Confirmed orders in the last 7 days.

batchWait.name: SCALE entries a winner may wait
batchWait.help: If its ad set stays frozen longer, it gets its own ad set or a retest.

testAds.name: Ads at most in a test

winOrders.name: Confirmed orders to win a test
winOrders.help: With a cost at or under the bid limit.

pendingHours.name: A lead with no answer becomes “unreachable” after
pendingHours.help: After this delay it is no longer “pending”.

postponeDays.name: A postponed customer waits at most
postponeDays.help: It is never counted as a refusal.

parcelDays.name: A parcel in delivery becomes a fake parcel after
parcelDays.help: If it is delivered later, Pilotix corrects it.

freezeDays.name: Length of the freeze
freezeDays.help: When the KPI “Learning restarted” is bad: no edit on that ad set during this time. Stops stay allowed.

brakeDays.name: Days in a row before the account brake
brakeDays.help: For the KPI “Account brake”: if your SCALE ads cost too much all that time, no new product is tested.

listTop.name: Actions shown in the daily list
listTop.help: Stops first, then the most important actions.

awarenessBudget.name: Budget of awareness and catalogue ads
awarenessBudget.help: These ads are outside the KPIs. Fill in your amount; until then Pilotix only shows what they spend.

how.title: How Pilotix decides
how.lead: The 10 ideas behind your KPIs, in simple words.
l: Each product has a bid limit: what a confirmed order may cost in ads.
An ad is judged on money first, then on its leads and parcels, then on the offer, the page and the video.
No ad is judged before it has run for {{days}}.
A stop needs proof: Pilotix switches off only when it is sure it is not bad luck. Few orders: it waits.
Before proof, a bad number means: fix it, and the ad set’s budget goes down one step.
When data is missing (no ad tag, calls not logged), Pilotix uses what is still exact and raises no budget.
Two KPIs that talk about the same thing never both act: one decides, and the most careful wins.
Stock always wins: at 0 pieces the ads are switched off. A product with no margin is paused.
TEST: launch on {{testDay}}, nothing is touched, verdict on the first {{judgeDay}} after the test ends: winner, not a winner, or one retest. Winners enter SCALE once a week.
When no rule decides, Pilotix does nothing on that ad, keeps the stops, and asks you.
how.noWait: An ad can be judged from its first hour: you set 0 days of waiting.
